artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime with $p \equiv 1 \pmod 4$, and let $Q \subset \mathbb{F}_p^*$ denote the set of nonzero quadratic residues modulo $p$. Consider subsets $A \subseteq \mathbb{F}_p$ with the property that $a - a' \in Q$ for every pair of distinct $a, a' \in A$ (equivalently, $A$ is a clique in the Paley graph on $\mathbb{F}_p$, whose vertex set is $\mathbb{F}_p$ and whose edges join $x, y$ with $x - y \in Q$). Let $\omega(p)$ denote the maximum size of such a set $A$.

Known lower bounds give $\omega(p) \geq (1/2 + o(1)) \log_2 p$ in general, and $\omega(p) \geq c \, \log p \, \log\log\log p$ for infinitely many primes $p$. The only generally known upper bound is the elementary estimate $\omega(p) < \sqrt{p}$.

Problem: Determine improved upper bounds on $\omega(p)$. In particular, prove or disprove that for every $\varepsilon > 0$ one has $\omega(p) < p^{\varepsilon}$ for all sufficiently large primes $p \equiv 1 \pmod 4$, and more generally describe the true asymptotic order of $\omega(p)$.

One may also pose the analogous questions with the difference set replaced by the sumset (i.e., $A + A \subseteq Q$, or $A + A = Q$, or $|(A+A) \triangle H|$ small), and with $Q$ replaced by an arbitrary proper multiplicative subgroup $H$ of $\mathbb{F}_q^*$: estimate the largest $A \subseteq \mathbb{F}_q$ with $A - A \subseteq H \cup \{0\}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The trivial bound $\omega(p) < \sqrt{p}$ was improved by Hanson and Petridis (2019/2021) using Stepanov's method to $\omega(p) \leq \sqrt{(p-1)/2} + 1$ (i.e. roughly $\sqrt{p/2}$). Further refinements and extensions to Paley graphs of prime-power order and to cyclotomic graphs have appeared since (e.g. Yip and collaborators, 2023–2025), and SOS lower-bound results (2023) suggest the polynomial-method approach has limitations. However, the conjectured polylogarithmic / $p^\varepsilon$ upper bound remains open.

status_evidence.title: The largest clique in the Paley Graph: unexpected significant progress
status_evidence.snippet: Hanson and Petridis used Stepanov's method to show ω(G_p) ≤ (1+o(1))√(p/2), a substantial improvement over the trivial √p bound.
status_evidence.claim: Hanson–Petridis improved the upper bound from √p to roughly √(p/2).

status_evidence.title: On the clique number of Paley graphs of prime power order
status_evidence.snippet: Extends the Hanson–Petridis method to Paley graphs of prime power order.
status_evidence.claim: The method has been extended but the asymptotic question remains open.

status_evidence.title: Exact values and improved bounds on the clique number of cyclotomic graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) improvements on clique numbers of cyclotomic graphs generalizing the Paley graph problem.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research; sharp asymptotic still unknown.

status_evidence.title: A Degree 4 Sum-of-Squares Lower Bound for the Clique Number of the Paley Graph
status_evidence.snippet: Proves limitations of SOS approaches to upper-bounding the Paley clique number.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the problem of polylogarithmic upper bounds remains open.
